firstPlayerRule: Choose a starting player. The rulebook suggests the first person to notice a rusty object as one possible way to decide.
houseFallback: Your group may choose the starter randomly. This is a house method for making the choice.
clarifications: Give the chosen starter the wrench. Turns proceed clockwise; the wrench marks the active player.
In solo mode, the human player takes the first turn, then alternates with the automated opponent.
interpretation: Spotting a rusty object is an example in the official rules, not a mandatory requirement.
